mapper.sql: FROM biz_medical_record r LEFT JOIN biz_patient p ON p.id = r.patient_id AND p.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_infectious_report ir ON ir.id = ( SELECT MAX(ir2.id) FROM biz_infectious_report ir2 WHERE ir2.regist_id = r.regist_id AND ir2.del_flag = 0 ) WHERE r.del_flag = 0 AND r.record_status IN (2, 3)
CASE WHEN r.temperature REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND CAST(r.temperature AS DECIMAL(4,1)) >= 37.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN r.diagnosis_code IS NOT NULL AND r.diagnosis_code <> '' AND r.diagnosis_code REGEXP CONCAT('^(', #{regex}, ')') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN ir.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

sql.if: AND (r.patient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.record_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.diagnosis_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT r.id AS recordId, r.record_no AS recordNo, r.regist_id AS registId, DATE_FORMAT(r.visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, r.patient_id AS patientId, r.patient_no AS patientNo, r.patient_name AS patientName, r.gender, r.age, p.phone, r.dept_name AS deptName, r.doctor_name AS doctorName, r.diagnosis_name AS diagnosisName, r.diagnosis_code AS diagnosisCode, r.temperature, AS fever, AS reportable, AS reported, ir.report_no AS reportNo, ir.report_status AS reportStatus, ir.disease_name AS reportDiseaseName, r.record_status AS recordStatus, r.sign_status AS signStatus
ORDER BY r.visit_date DESC, r.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM( = 1) AS feverCount, SUM( = 1) AS reportableCount, SUM( = 1 AND = 0) AS pendingCount, SUM( = 1 AND = 1) AS reportedCount
